prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory room catalog in `Solution.java`. Define immutable nested public static final classes `Student` (`int id`, `String name`), `Room` (`int id`, `String name`, `int roomNumber`, `List<Student> students`), and `Page` (`List<Room> items`, `int pageNumber`, `int pageSize`, `int totalMatches`). Constructors and getters must be public except the `Page` constructor may be private. `Room` must defensively copy its student list and expose an unmodifiable list.

Implement `public static Page listRooms(List<Room> rooms, String namePrefix, int pageNumber, int pageSize)`. Pagination is zero-based. `rooms` and its elements must be non-null, `pageNumber` must be non-negative, and `pageSize` must be positive; otherwise throw `IllegalArgumentException`. A null prefix means no name filter. A non-null prefix, including empty, matches names using case-sensitive `startsWith`; a room with a null name does not match a non-null prefix. Preserve input order, return an unmodifiable snapshot page, and return an empty item list when the requested page is beyond the matches.

Also implement `public static Room findRoom(List<Room> rooms, int id, int roomNumber)`, applying the same list validation and returning the first matching reference or null. Neither method may mutate the supplied list.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
